# Adapters Quickstart

This guide shows how to mount Persona agent infrastructure onto your backend using `@personaai/adapters`.

Select your framework below:

---

## 1. Express Setup

Mount Persona routes onto an Express router with user session authentication:

```bash
npm install @personaai/adapters express
npm install -D @types/express
```

```ts
// server.ts
import express from 'express';
import { createExpressAdapter } from '@personaai/adapters/express';

const app = express();
app.use(express.json());

// 1. Initialize the Persona Express Adapter
const { router, runtime } = createExpressAdapter({
  baseUrl: process.env.PERSONA_BASE_URL || 'https://api.persona.hasanraiyan.me',
  credential: process.env.PERSONA_CREDENTIAL!, // "<keyId>.<secret>"
  
  // 2. Resolve the logged-in user from Express request
  resolveUserFrom: (req) => {
    // Return external user ID (e.g. from session or JWT)
    return req.headers['x-user-id'] as string ?? null;
  },
});

// 3. Mount under your desired API prefix
app.use('/api/persona', router);

const server = app.listen(3000, () => {
  console.log('Express Persona server running on http://localhost:3000/api/persona');
});

// 4. Clean shutdown
process.on('SIGTERM', () => {
  runtime.close();
  server.close();
});
```

## 2. Next.js Setup (App Router)

Set up a catch-all route handler in Next.js 14+ with Clerk authentication:

```bash
npm install @personaai/adapters next react @clerk/nextjs
```

### Server Route Handler

Create `app/api/persona/[...persona]/route.ts`:

```ts
// app/api/persona/[...persona]/route.ts
import { createPersonaHandler } from '@personaai/adapters/nextjs/server';
import { auth } from '@clerk/nextjs/server';

export const { GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE } = createPersonaHandler({
  baseUrl: process.env.PERSONA_BASE_URL || 'https://api.persona.hasanraiyan.me',
  credential: process.env.PERSONA_CREDENTIAL!,
  
  // Resolve current user asynchronously using Clerk
  resolveUserFrom: async () => {
    const session = await auth();
    return session.userId ?? null;
  },
});

// Next.js Route Segments Configuration
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
export const runtime = 'nodejs';
```

### Client Provider & Chat Component

Wrap your app with `PersonaProvider` from `@personaai/adapters/nextjs`:

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import { PersonaProvider } from '@personaai/adapters/nextjs';

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        <PersonaProvider baseUrl="/api/persona">
          {children}
        </PersonaProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

Now any client component can consume the standard hooks:

```tsx
// app/chat/page.tsx
'use client';

import { useChat } from '@personaai/adapters/nextjs';

export default function ChatPage() {
  const { messages, input, setInput, sendMessage, isStreaming } = useChat({
    agentId: '68f12a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d',
  });

  return (
    <div className="p-4 max-w-lg mx-auto">
      <div className="space-y-2 mb-4">
        {messages.map((m, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={m.role === 'user' ? 'text-right' : 'text-left'}>
            <span className="inline-block p-2 rounded bg-muted text-sm">{m.content}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); sendMessage(); }} className="flex gap-2">
        <input
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Ask something..."
          className="border p-2 rounded flex-1"
        />
        <button type="submit" disabled={isStreaming} className="bg-primary text-white px-4 py-2 rounded">
          Send
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 3. NestJS Setup

Integrate Persona into a modular NestJS application with dependency injection:

```bash
npm install @personaai/adapters @nestjs/common @nestjs/core reflect-metadata rxjs
```

### Module Registration

```ts
// app.module.ts
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigModule, ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PersonaModule } from '@personaai/adapters/nestjs';

@Module({
  imports: [
    ConfigModule.forRoot({ isGlobal: true }),
    PersonaModule.forRootAsync({
      inject: [ConfigService],
      useFactory: (config: ConfigService) => ({
        baseUrl: config.getOrThrow('PERSONA_BASE_URL'),
        credential: config.getOrThrow('PERSONA_CREDENTIAL'),
        routePrefix: '/api/persona',
        resolveUserFrom: (req) => req.user?.id ?? req.headers['x-user-id'] ?? null,
      }),
    }),
  ],
})
export class AppModule {}
```

### Injecting PersonaService

`PersonaService` is globally available and provides user-scoped Persona SDK clients:

```ts
// agent-trigger.service.ts
import{} from '@nestjs/common';
import{} from '@personaai/adapters/nestjs';

@Injectable()
export class AgentTriggerService {
  constructor(private readonly persona: PersonaService) {}

  async runBackgroundWorkflow(userId: string, agentId: string) {
    // Get an SDK client scoped to this specific user
    const client = this.persona.forUser(userId);

    const thread = await client.threads.create{});
    console.log(`Created thread {} for user {}`);
    return thread;
  }
}
```
